Episode 156. Purification of Chaos (1)
"Hahaha!"
"To Jin, our brother!"
"To our brother!"
The royal siblings, who were talking as if Jin was about to meet his end just an hour ago, are now enjoying a lively drinking party without a break.
They were exaggerating their excitement to consider Jin's feelings, but Jin was so anxious and curious that he didn't even know where the alcohol was going.
"Brother Jin."
It was the first time Ban had spoken since the party started.
"Whew, finally you're talking to me, Brother Ban. You should also give me a chance to speak."
When Jin spoke in a disappointed tone, Ban smiled.
Should she say he reminded her of a cute younger brother? While she was worried, she was also welcoming the vibrancy of Lafrarosa that she hadn't seen in a long time.
Like all the other siblings.
Jin wasn't really upset.
"I needed some time to sort out my thoughts. How to purify you, my brother."
The noisy chatter stopped. All the royal siblings put down their glasses and focused their gaze on Jin and Ban.
Jin recalled what his brothers had said.
The royal siblings are fundamentally immune to chaos, but 'the first chaos' is not.
"It seems I'm not the first brother to be tainted by the 'first chaos'. I don't know what chaos with the modifier 'first' means."
"It refers to the chaos originating from the witch. Now, she's called Helrum, as we mentioned."

"Yes, Joshua Runkandel, who fought against summoned Garmund brother once. After I left Lafrarosa last time, I found a clue that the prophet, who is his backer, might be Helrum. The recording device I obtained from killing the demons in his villa belonged to Helrum."
"First, tell us what you've been through. We will explain after hearing everything."
"If I were to tell everything, it would take all night."
The eyes of his siblings were gleaming.
The siblings knew nothing about all the things Jin had been through since he left Lafrarosa last time.

Becoming the family's rider, finding the tombs of Tamar, acquiring the legacy left by the old Runkandel, meeting Valeria, discovering the truth of the fairy race, growing his forces, bringing Joshua down, opposing the king of chaos, acquiring the relics left by Rokia, and so on...
Not even two years had passed, but Jin had gone through experiences far beyond what his siblings had anticipated.
Jin's story didn't end until noon the next day.
"Wow... it feels like I've heard a legend or myth."
"Right. The Sato brothers and Shaku brothers directly participated in Jin's saga, didn't they?"
"And Garmund was summoned too!"
"Damn, I'm jealous! I wanted to be chosen too!"
"But... Nana, Paltoo, and Shaku brothers don't remember at all. Don't be too jealous..."
"Why don't you change that proud look on your face and say something like that, Sato brothers?"
Jin chuckled as he watched the reactions of his brothers, who were known as the true legendary battle race.
"By the way, the demon that the Sato brothers mentioned they had encountered with us. His name was Orugal, the Demon King, wasn't it?"
"If Linpa brothers warned Jin that he's dangerous, I should remember... but I'm hearing that name for the first time."
"There weren't many demons in that era that were remarkable enough for us to remember."
"Wasn't the strongest one, the guy who was hanging out with the witch?"
"Then, he must be Orugal, the Demon King, brothers. The reason you don't remember is because Zipl manipulated history."
"Hmm, it's unbelievable that those who aren't even gods manipulate history. Not just writing history to the winner's liking, but manipulating it like correcting a text..."
"Listening to Jin, even if the combat power of those Zipl guys is worthless, their power has already reached the realm of gods. They even have a thing that replicates the Origin Stone."
"The role of that record magician would be very important. The outside world now can modify even the truth that someone clearly knew at any time."
The royal siblings knew exactly what the Origin Stone was.
It was the power of the gods that destroyed them.
On the other hand, they seemed to know almost nothing about Zipl's manipulation of history.
Because there was no overlap between the activities of the royal siblings and Zipl.
A thousand years ago, they had interacted with Tamar who came as a successor and heard about Zipl from him.
But it was only fragmentary, and the last image of Tamar that Ban remembered was not in a very intact state.
"Brothers, I forgot to mention one really important thing. Now, pay attention."
The brothers turned their heads all at once, like cats watching a moving toy.
"The component of the space-time device I mentioned at the end. I believe that item could be the key to get you out to the outside world."
Clank, a few of the siblings dropped their glasses on the floor at his words. There were those who hiccupped in surprise, and even Ban's pupils grew larger.

"We already have on our side a likely greatest genius in the history of engineering, and a record magician who can restore the records of the space-time device. And I will use their abilities to free you, I promise."
Until Jin first came to Lafrarosa as the successor of the Spirit Sword,
The brothers had never hoped that they would be able to escape this dead world.
So when Jin first started his training, they consciously avoided talking about the outside world.
Because talking about a land they could never return to would only make their punishment heavier.
Yet a few of the brothers continued to dream of the outside.
One of them was the war god Ban, and she transfused her blood to Jin for that very reason. She thought that through Jin, the brothers could be saved.
Now, not only Ban, but everyone believed so.
Because right now, Jin declared that he would do so.
"The outside world... Just hearing about it sounds wonderful."
"Hahaha, is it time for the reign of us, the kings, once again!"
"Jin's enemy is our enemy! The moment we are released, they will face their doom!"
"The problem is."
Jin rolled up his sleeve to reveal the black spot of chaos.
At this, a grave look quickly replaced the excited expressions on the brothers' faces.
"This."
"The original chaos. Urazil, I totally forgot..."
"You scared me like that and you just forgot?"
"If something goes wrong with Jin, the space-time device and everything else become meaningless."
"Even if something happens to me, the rest of my companions will continue to work to free you, but it would be better if I am there. I am the only one who can enter Lafrarosa directly."
Jin made eye contact with Ban.
"Brother Ban. Unlike the other brothers who talk as if I will certainly die or transform strangely, you seem to think that purification is quite possible."
Ban nodded in response.

"Brothers, fortunately, the chaos that has consumed Jin is not purely left by the witch alone. Although it takes a similar form, according to Jin's explanation... it's mixed with the fragments of the original stone and the power of the gods, so it can't be called the original chaos in its entirety."
"Oh, so it's just the original chaos mixed with a bit?"
"Well. It's a power that shouldn't exist in the world, so if it does exist, it must be in very small amounts."
"So in the purification process, the chances of Jin going mad or losing his intelligence and becoming a beast would be lower. Unlucky, he could even turn into a bug."
"He could change sex or become a hermaphrodite."
All of them sounded horrifying just by hearing it. Jin was then able to understand why the brothers were fussing about what condition he might be in.
'So there are other types of demonic transformations apart from becoming a monster.'
A mistake of the gods, chaos originating from the original stone destroys the ego of the consumed target and turns him into a monster, but...
The 'original chaos' that Helrum possessed had a bizarre power to completely disfigure the essence of the target.
Whether the target becomes a monster or a beast could not be known until the outcome is revealed.
And the chaos that has consumed Jin was a mixture of the chaos of the god and Helrum, as Ban described.

"The white stone that sealed the fragments of the original stone. Before it became the possession of the Hyran family, the witch must have had it. At that time, the original chaos that the witch had must have been attached to Gllieak."
If the chaos consuming Jin had been entirely Gllieak's, Ban wouldn't have worried about him.
Although Jin is a human, he has the blood of a war god along with his heart of light.
If he continues to temper them, Jin could also become immune to chaos like the other brothers. To all kinds of chaos except the original chaos.
'Then, mother and Kellyak. And other people infected with chaos at the time...!'
Just as Jin was about to think of that, Ban continued the explanation.

"Jin, in my opinion, you're the only one who was infected with the original chaos in the battle with Gllieak. If a normal human without the blood of a war god like you were consumed by the original chaos, the result should have already appeared."
Even the brothers couldn't resist Helrum's chaos.
"It's a bit of a relief to hear this, but I don't understand why I was the only one exposed to the witch's chaos."

"Because the witch hates Soldierlet. Because Soldierlet completely sealed the original chaos that the witch had. Jin, you were infected with the original chaos that the witch left before being sealed. The fact that you safely made it to Lafrarosa means that the witch's chaos that colored you is much weaker than we remember."
It was an unexpected story for Jin. He naturally perceived it as Gllieak's chaos.
"......Anyway, there is a definite method of purification. We should start as soon as possible."
"We need some time to prepare. In the meantime, let the other brothers check the achievements Jin has made outside."
